router: Train standardized L2 logistic regression C=0.001, max_iter=2000 on training source domain (Kaggle=0, RSNA=1), weighted equally over four source/class strata. Fold scaler into Dense. RSNA branch when logit>=0, else original branch. No router hyperparameter/threshold search.

interpretation: Router predicts similarity to two development sources, not patient age, acquisition institution, anatomy, clinical diagnosis or reliability.
